test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which is the correct sequence of oceans according to size (from largest to smallest)?

options.text: Pacific Ocean > Antarctic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Atlantic Ocean
Pacific Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean > Atlantic Ocean
Pacific Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean
Pacific Ocean > Indian Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Antarctic Ocean

solution: The correct answer is __**Pacific Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The correct sequence of oceans according to size (from largest to smallest) Pacific Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean.
